bands.why: The first row (a bag of 24 gentle tiles) is the warm-up: a reasonable player places every tile (1.0 measured).
The hardest row (36 knotty tiles, few helpful deals) is hard (0.2 measured), yet a reasonable player still wins some.
Random placement still wins about half the warm-up levels (0.55 measured): the board is roomy there, but it scores less than half of a reasonable player.
From the third row random placement almost never fits the whole bag (0.04 measured): where a tile goes matters.
A second-row level is its bag of 28 tiles (median 28 measured): a few minutes of play.
A reasonable player scores about 760 on a third-row level, which sets its stars (two at the witness score).
The double (one tile closes a road and a river) comes about twice per easy level (1.75 measured), the opening's first.
An endless run outlasts a level (median 37 placements measured) and still ends: the board fills.
A reasonable endless run scores more than a level (median 970 measured).
Doubles still come in the endless run (1.38 per run measured).

notes: Trail Clear, four tuning rows on the 0..100 scale sampled at their lower bounds (0/25/50/75) and the endless run at 100, 100 seeds each. Greedy wins 1.0/0.88/0.65/0.2, random 0.55/0.17/0.04/0.02, lookahead 0.92 at the second row; the curve drops by 0.12, 0.23 and 0.45. Winning is placing the whole bag, so the skill gap is judged on the score the stars use: random 240 < greedy 710 < lookahead 960 at the second row. The opening deals the ford between a road end and a river end, so the greedy player closes two loops with its first tile in every run (first payoff within 3 placements: 1.0) and sees the double 1.75 times per easy level. The first sim showed random placement winning 0.65 of the warm-up and a second row barely harder than the first (greedy 0.94 after 1.0); the easiest row now deals fewer helpful tiles (40 -> 32 %) and the second row fewer end pieces (4 -> 3 each). The endless run lasts a median 37 placements (p10 22, p90 60), always ends with no room, and scores a median 970. Proposed until the owner's play-test (O6).
